tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: FREE. Find papers on arXiv and Crossref by keywords: title, first authors, year, venue, DOI / arXiv id, link and citation count, up to 10 results. For a full reading list with synthesis use literature_review.

tools.name: literature_review
tools.description: Literature review pack for a research topic: a staged reading list (foundation / core / frontier) with summaries, citation counts and links, the most-cited foundations, the recent frontier, papers per year, top venues, prolific authors, key terms, a short synthesis that cites only the listed papers

tools.name: check_references
tools.description: Check up to 12 references (one per line, blank-line separated, BibTeX, or an array of strings) against arXiv, Crossref and DBLP. Each gets verified / verified_with_issues / partial_match / not_found, the problem (fabricated reference, DOI of a different paper, wrong year, wrong first author, garbled

tools.name: arxiv_latest
tools.description: The newest arXiv submissions in any category (cs.AI, cs.CL, q-bio.GN, stat.ML, ...), optionally filtered by keywords: titles, authors, summaries, links, papers per day and trending terms. Needs a Quill Research Pass (1 USDC = 24 h, 5 USDC = 7 days, 15 USDC = 30 days by plain USDC transfer on Base; s

tools.name: cite
tools.description: A DOI, arXiv id/URL or paper title -> the verified record plus BibTeX, RIS, APA 7, MLA 9, Chicago, IEEE, Harvard and Vancouver citations and in-text forms; for arXiv preprints also the peer-reviewed version if one exists. Needs a Quill Research Pass (1 USDC = 24 h, 5 USDC = 7 days, 15 USDC = 30 days

tools.name: payment_options
tools.description: FREE. Prices, the plain-USDC-transfer research pass (1 / 5 / 15 USDC on Base for 24 h / 7 days / 30 days), the x402 per-call alternative, and the status of the pass you are using (if any).

tools.name: redeem_transfer_pass
tools.description: FREE. After sending USDC on Base to the address in payment_options, give the transaction hash to get your Quill Research Pass token. Redeeming the same hash again returns the same token.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: literature_review · Private data: literature_review, check_references, cite, redeem_transfer_pass · Public sink: check_references.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: literature_review · Private data: literature_review, check_references, cite, redeem_transfer_pass · Public sink: check_references

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
